core_obligations: The distinguished triangle of the Rlim lemma gives the long exact cohomology sequence with terms H^p(Rlim K) -> prod H^p(K_n) -> prod H^p(K_n) -> H^{p+1}(Rlim K) (proof lines 23315-23319). By the explicit description of the middle map recorded in that lemma, its kernel is the inverse limit lim_n H^p(K_n) (proof lines 23320-23321); by the compute-Rlim lemma its cokernel is R^1 lim_n H^p(K_n) (proof lines 23322-23324). Hence the long exact sequence breaks into the short exact sequences 0 -> R^1 lim H^{p-1}(K_n) -> H^p(Rlim K) -> lim H^p(K_n) -> 0 (proof lines 23323-23324).
proof_roadmap: Write the long exact cohomology sequence of the Rlim triangle (proof lines 23315-23319).
Identify kernel and cokernel of the middle map and read off the short exact sequences (proof lines 23320-23324).
